==English==
{{wp|,+ (finance)}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|id=physics|:bor|la:mōmentum<id:movement>|tree=1|text=1}} {{doublet|en|moment|movement}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˌmə(ʊ)ˈmɛntəm/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˌmoʊˈmɛntəm/|a=GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-momentum.ogg|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˌməʉˈmentəm/|a=AU}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˌmɐʉˈmentəm/|a=NZ}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~|s|momenta}}

# {{lb|en|physics}} Of a [[body]] in [[motion]]: the [[tendency]] of a body to [[maintain]] its [[inertial]] [[motion]]; the [[product]] of its [[mass#Noun|mass]] and [[velocity]], or the [[vector]] [[sum]] of the [[products]] of its [[mass#Noun|masses]] and [[velocity|velocities]].
# {{lb|en|physics}} Strength or force gained by motion or movement.
# The [[impetus]], either of a body in motion, or of an [[idea]] or [[course#Noun|course]] of [[event]]s; a [[moment]].
#* {{RQ:Hardy Two on a Tower|volume=II|chapter=II|page=31|passage=Their intention to become husband and wife, at first halting and timorous, had accumulated '''momentum''' with the lapse of hours, till it now bore down every obstacle in its course.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|author=Jane Shilling|title=The Golden Thread: the Story of Writing, by Ewan Clayton, review [print edition: Illuminating language]|url=http://www.telegraph.co.uk/culture/books/historybookreviews/10304108/The-Golden-Thread-the-Story-of-Writing-by-Ewan-Clayton-review.html|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20250711011038/https://www.telegraph.co.uk/culture/books/historybookreviews/10304108/The-Golden-Thread-the-Story-of-Writing-by-Ewan-Clayton-review.html|archivedate=11 July 2025|work={{w|The Daily Telegraph}} (Review)|date=14 September 2013|page=R29|passage=Though his account of written communication over the past 5,000 years necessarily has a powerful forward '''momentum''', his diversions down the fascinating byways of the subject are irresistible ...}}
# {{lb|en|finance}} The [[surmise]] of an [[accelerated]] [[price]] [[trend]] in the [[analysis]] ([[technical analysis|technical]] or [[fundamental analysis|fundamental]]) of an [[asset]].
